text:
sarah-partners: Heads up — Zephyr marketplace PO is stuck in their portal. Procurement flags missing 'billing_entity_id' and Legal flagged a non-standard indemnity clause on the PO. Need a quick unblock before EOD.

mike-sales: Is this PO 2024-0418? I have the quote id. What's exact blocker on billing entity? Zephyr's portal complains about vendor alias.

procurement-bot: INCOMING: PO 2024-0418 created by Zephyr. Status: PENDING - Missing billing_entity_id. Assigned to @devin-ops.

devin-ops: Looking now — their portal requires a 10-digit vendor ID that we don't expose via marketplace. We could add a vendor_alias mapping (e.g. RW-EXT-01) to satisfy their validation.

elaine-legal: @sarah-partners @mike-sales send me the PO PDF and the redline. If it's their standard indemnity we can accept with mutual carveouts; if it's broad we'll need to escalate to Org Legal.

jordan-eng: FYI our private-offer flow also expects sku mapping to include marketplace_sku + internal_sku. Zephyr's SKU 'Z-REQ-LLM-XL' isn't mapped which may explain portal rejection in some cases.

sarah-partners: Uploaded PO + screenshot of portal error here: https://zephyr.marketplace/po/2024-0418 (external link). Portal error: 'billing_entity_id missing'.

mike-sales: I pinged Zephyr rep — they can set billing_entity_id if we give them our tax jurisdiction ID (EIN + country). Is it okay to share EIN through portal?

elaine-legal: We can share EIN under NDA. Prefer SFTP or encrypted email over pasting into partner portal. @sarah-partners please request SFTP creds from Zephyr.

devin-ops: Workaround: I can add a vendor_alias mapping on our marketplace integration so Zephyr's portal accepts 'RW-EXT-01' as the billing entity. Small change, ~2h including deploy. Can do if prioritized.

sarah-partners: Zephyr says they need this for their invoice run tomorrow morning PST. Can we push the mapping now? @devin-ops prioritize please.

devin-ops: I have a critical infra patch in 20m but I can take this next. ETA ~2h. I'll post commit + deploy logs here.

mike-sales: If delay >2h they might cancel and reissue Monday. Please prioritize.

elaine-legal: Redline summary: Section 9 (Indemnity) - replace overly broad language with mutual indemnity and add liability cap equal to contract value. I'll draft language and send to Zephyr; if they refuse, escalate to org legal.

jordan-eng: Also note: we need an internal price override for marketplace discounts to avoid invoice mismatch later. Not blocking PO creation but will affect billing.

sarah-partners: Plan: @devin-ops add mapping; @elaine-legal send suggested redline; @mike-sales push Zephyr to accept SFTP for EIN. I'll chase externally.

procurement-bot: UPDATE: PO 2024-0418 status CHANGED -> QUEUED_FOR_VENDOR_ALIAS_UPDATE by devin-ops at 1729500120.

devin-ops: Deploy done. mapping RW-EXT-01 added to vendor_alias table. Portal test returned 200 and accepted billing_entity_id. Notified Zephyr to resubmit. Commit: git.redwood/marketplace@c3f5b2 (logs uploaded).

mike-sales: Zephyr confirmed they could resubmit and issued 2024-0418-R1. @elaine-legal did you get the updated PDF?

elaine-legal: Sent redline via encrypted email; Zephyr accepted the liability cap with minor wording tweaks. I uploaded final signed PDF to SFTP and shared creds in 1:1.

sarah-partners: Closing loop — PO accepted, invoice window preserved. Filing a short note for partnerships runbook about vendor_alias quick-fix. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
